info.title: Fenergo Nebula Data Protection Command
info.description:
**Data Protection Command API**:
Data Protection API provides both configurational and operational methods related to the client Data Protection policies. Use the Data Protection Command API to create and manage Jurisdictions. Use the Data Protection Query API to retrieve Jurisdtiction aggregates.
**Data Protection API provides**:
  • The ability to create, update and delete Data Protection Regimes.
